description: Recent news articles (last ~72 hours) that match a query, from GDELT's public Context 2.0 API (DOC 2.0 API as fallback), no key: title, URL, domain, language, time seen and the matching sentence. Supports GDELT query syntax ("exact phrase", sourcelang:english, domain:bbc.co.uk). Covers the sources GDELT monitors, not every outlet. Rate-limited or slow GDELT answers return 503. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
